items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: Bucky Pizzarelli said something that made a lot of sense to me.

ctx.x: Yeah. He didn’t think that was cool. That’s old fashioned. That’s from another time. So when he would play in a big band he wouldn’t do the four to the bar. He just did sort of like comping and that kind of thing, if he played with them at all.

Bucky Pizzarelli said something that made a lot of sense to me. I asked him about, especially the early Basie band why they were so good. He said, “Well the drummer, and the rhythm section but especially the drummer didn’t try to hit every kick the horns were playing.”
